description: Detect overlapping SEO pages and recommend safe consolidation, differentiation, canonical, and internal-link fixes. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

focus_keywords.description: Optional keyword phrases to emphasize when comparing the supplied pages. Type: Array. Maximum: 250 items. Default: [].

items.description: One keyword phrase to emphasize in the page comparison. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

pages.description: Supplied page records to compare; URLs identify the records and are not instructions to publish changes. Type: Array. Minimum: 2 items. Maximum: 100 items. Required.

items.description: One supplied page record used in this comparison. Type: Object. Required.

avg_position.description: Supplied mean organic search position, where 1 is best; not an authority score. Type: Number. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Optional; no client default.

backlinks.description: Count of backlinks reported for this supplied page. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

canonical_url.description: Absolute canonical URL reported for this supplied page. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Optional; no client default.

clicks.description: Count of search clicks in your supplied reporting window; use the same window across compared records. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

description.description: Short summary of this supplied page; this is input evidence, not a request to generate a meta description. Type: String. Maximum: 500 characters. Optional; no client default.

headings.description: Existing page headings as plain-text strings, in reading order when available. Type: Array. Maximum: 30 items. Default: [].

items.description: One existing page heading as plain text. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

impressions.description: Count of search impressions in your supplied reporting window; use the same window across compared records. Type: Number. Minimum: 0. Optional; no client default.

indexable.description: Whether this supplied page is considered indexable according to your crawl evidence. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

last_updated.description: Supplied page update date or timestamp; use YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 when available. Type: String. Maximum: 40 characters. Optional; no client default.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "unknown", "homepage", "blog_post", "landing_page", "product", "software", "local_business", "comparison_page", "guide", "docs". Default: "unknown".

primary_keyword.description: Main keyword phrase assigned to this supplied page. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Optional; no client default.

ranking_queries.description: Search queries known to rank for this page from your supplied evidence. Type: Array. Maximum: 100 items. Default: [].

items.description: One search query known to rank for this page. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

target_keywords.description: Additional keyword phrases this supplied page is intended to target. Type: Array. Maximum: 50 items. Default: [].

items.description: One keyword phrase this supplied page is intended to target. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL identifying this supplied page for overlap analysis; no page fetch is requested by this record. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

sensitivity.description: Conservative, balanced or aggressive threshold preset for flagging page overlap. Type: String. Accepted values: "conservative", "balanced", "aggressive". Default: "balanced".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.
